item.title: Temporary Closure Planned for Fountain Creek Regional Trail Beginning January 12
item.description: January 7, 2026 – A temporary closure of the Fountain Creek Regional Trail will begin Monday, January 12, 2026, to allow Colorado Springs Utilities (CSU) to complete a major powerline infrastructure upgrade. Colorado Springs Utilities is replacing existing wooden powerline poles with modern steel monopoles to support a wider variety of electric transmission lines.… The post Temporary Closure Planned for Fountain Creek Regional Trail Beginning January 12 appeared first on El Paso County Colorado.
